description: Get OilPriceAPI's own operational status: overall health score and grade, component status, and per-update-tier (realtime, daily, weekly, monthly) health from the API's latest background health calculation. Set include_commodities=true to list the series in each tier that are not healthy or not current. Use when the user asks whether OilPriceAPI is up or degraded, or why data looks delayed. This is service health, not market data. Works without an API key. When the API's snapshot is missing or at least 15 minutes old it answers HTTP 503 and this tool reports health as unknown.

include_commodities.description: When true, list series in each tier that are not healthy or not current (default: false).

name: opa_get_service_status
title: Get Service Status
